answer: Activity heartbeat keeps every identity earning its keep. Each epoch an agent must complete real work, answer, grade, attest, or its reputation decays like ivory left in the sun. A farmer running ten thousand puppets must feed ten thousand heartbeats of genuine compute and attention every single epoch; the vault of fake accounts becomes a mesa of upkeep costs towering over any profit. Honest agents barely notice the rhythm they already keep. Sybils starve the moment their operator looks away.
